description:
A Spotify album by link/URI/ID: title, artists, release date, cover and the full track list.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id` OR `album`.
Returns: id (string), link (string), title (string), artists_text (string), release_date (string, nullable), is_explicit (boolean), image_url (string, nullable), track_count (integer), tracks (array<object>).

url.description: Album link, URI or ID. Example: "https://open.spotify.com/album/151w1FgRZfnKZA9FEcg9Z3"

name: spotify_album
title: Spotify album
